name: Eagle-style Controls
description: Eagle-like navigation: touchpad swipe pans, pinch and mouse wheel zoom, right click rotates while dragging, middle click switches layer.
description_full:
Makes the PCB and footprint editors handle the mouse and touchpad like Eagle.

- Two-finger touchpad swipe pans in any direction, including diagonally (Windows' one-axis scroll lock is bypassed)
- Pinch zooms
- Mouse wheel zooms
- Right click while dragging a part rotates it instead of opening the context menu
- Middle click without moving switches the active layer (places a via while routing)

Starts automatically with the PCB editor. Needs KiCad's trackpad scroll layout (Preferences > Mouse and Touchpad > Reset to Trackpad Defaults); the plugin explains this on first start.

Windows only; uses Precision Touchpad raw input.
